capabilities: capitalize the first letter of each line as you type
skip capitalization inside code blocks, math, and frontmatter
ignore lines starting with links, URLs, and tags
capitalize past list markers, checkboxes, and blockquotes
respect manual lowercase overwrites on the current line
extras: No settings or commands; it only works automatically once enabled. Manual installation instructions are given, but no usage examples or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in auto-capitalization, so writers must manually fix lowercase line starts without breaking code blocks, math, or links.
summary: Typing assistant that automatically capitalizes the first letter of each line while skipping code, math, frontmatter, links, and Markdown syntax.
